news.title: Mizzou researchers uncover key insight into mini-stroke treatment
news.summary_en: New research finds lower-dose aspirin is more effective than higher doses in two-drug antiplatelet therapy, helping standardize treatment during the period when patients face the greatest risk of a major stroke.

news.title: As he turns 40, Truman picks up some age-appropriate hobbies and habits
news.summary_en: From lawn care to grilling, Mizzou’s beloved mascot celebrates a milestone birthday across the campus he calls home.

news.title: Never forgotten: Mizzou commemorates 25 years since 9/11
news.summary_en: The University of Missouri and the City of Columbia marked the 25th anniversary of Sept. 11, 2001, with a Patriot Day wreath-laying ceremony honoring the lives lost.

news.title: With help from journalism students, Robert Greene’s documentary premieres at Venice Film Festival
Mizzou researcher describes two previously unknown insect species
news.summary_en: Sites’ work adds to decades of research at the university documenting Earth’s biodiversity through taxonomy and field exploration.

news.title: Mizzou helps Missouri turn good neighbors into stronger communities
news.summary_en: MU Extension’s Missouri Good Neighbor Week has grown from a statewide celebration into a movement inspiring communities across the country.

news.title: CAFNR leader receives Lifetime Achievement Award
news.summary_en: Bryan Garton was honored with the award from the Missouri Vocational Agriculture Teachers Association and the National Association of Agricultural Educators.

news.title: Mizzou researchers chart new course for AI-powered biomedical discoveries
news.summary_en: An emerging form of artificial intelligence could give scientists a clearer view of how living systems change over time and accelerate the pace of medical discoveries.

news.title: Meet the people behind Mizzou’s momentum: Five questions with President Mun Choi
news.summary_en: In the first installment of "Five Questions," President Mun Choi reflects on leadership, innovation and guiding the university through a period of growth.

news.title: It takes more than school spirit to be Truman the Tiger
news.summary_en: Mizzou sport science experts are helping the university’s beloved mascot prepare for the physical demands of performing on game day.
